Synopsis:
    Andrew and Tristan Tate, arrested in Miami on July 18, are seeking bail in a Miami federal court while contesting extradition to the UK on rape, assault and sexual trafficking charges. UK's Crown Prosecution Service brought new charges covering alleged offenses against four victims (2010–2017), on top of prior charges relating to three victims. Prosecutors argue for detention citing flight risk and community danger; defense counters with compliance record and proposes bond/monitoring conditions. The extradition process could span months, with Britain's full submission due to the State Department by September 16.
